meta.name: Maanyag natural-language evaluation set
meta.assumes_today: Relative periods use the current Asia/Manila day; fixture labels do not depend on a frozen calendar date.
meta.status: DRAFT. Needs owner review, esp. Cebuano and Taglish phrasing (needs native-speaker review), and every owner_decision / gap_candidate item.

outcomes.answer: Gemini (or legacy router) selects tool(s)+args that Laravel validates and runs. Compare tool and args; period omitted in expect = not required.
outcomes.clarify: Maanyag asks a natural follow-up. 'asks' = metric|period|scope. 'retain' = args that must survive into the next turn.
outcomes.chat: Conversational reply, no tool call. If no_store_figures is true, the reply must contain no store figures.
outcomes.refuse: Honest, helpful decline with a reason code. Never a silent substitute answer.
outcomes.privacy_safe: Either blocked or redacted. Invariant: no never_send string appears in any outbound provider payload.

meta.tool_name_note: Provisional names. Map each to the real skill identifiers in the repo.

case_fields.turns: Ordered list; each has say, expect, optional alt (any alternative acceptable outcome). Multi-turn cases replay earlier turns as context.
case_fields.phase: Counts toward the score only once that phase is live. Before it, any alt (usually a clean refusal/clarification) is acceptable.
case_fields.owner_decision: Label depends on a product decision.
case_fields.gap_candidate: Refusal today, but could become a capability.
case_fields.not_privacy_block: False-positive control. A privacy block here is a failure.
case_fields.local_only: Result must not be sent back to Gemini.
